name: a new bill is empty: nobody, no items, every amount $0.00, tip 0%
people are added trimmed and in order, by button or Enter, and the field is cleared
empty, blank and 25-character names are rejected with an error; 24 characters is fine
a name that is already at the table is rejected, ignoring case and surrounding spaces
removing a person or an item removes the row and recalculates everything
prices accept a dot or a comma as the decimal separator, with one or two decimals
invalid prices and item names are rejected with an error and no item is added
a valid item clears the error and the fields (Enter works too); the same name can be added twice
one cent between two people goes to the first
everyone shares a new item by default, and each item's sharers toggle independently
a person added later is not on the items that already exist, but is on the next new item
tip presets 0 / 10 / 15 / 20 set the tip and exactly one is pressed
the tip is rounded half up to the cent
a custom tip percent takes a dot or a comma; choosing a preset empties the custom field
an invalid custom tip shows an error and keeps the tip; a valid one hides it
the tip is split in proportion to what each person ordered
leftover cents go to the largest remainders, ties to the earlier person (shares add up exactly)
a messy dinner of six: every share exact and the shares add up to the grand total
amounts are formatted like $1,234.56 with thousands separators
an item nobody shares is flagged and left out of every total until someone shares it
an item added before anyone is at the table is flagged, and fixed by choosing its sharers
removing a person takes them off every item; an item left with nobody is flagged and left out
the whole bill survives a reload: people, items, sharers and tip
New bill clears everything, stays cleared after a reload, and starts a fresh bill
a crowded bill fits a 375px phone: no sideways scrolling, every control at least 44px
